items.name: 3W synthetic well synthetic_3w_well_00001
items.description: Synthetic well derived from the Petrobras 3W dataset. Holds the well's asset model (subsystems, equipment, instruments), its TimeSeries, and the relationship edges between them. See metadata for attribution and licensing (CC BY 4.0).

metadata.attribution: Vargas, R.E.V. et al. (2019). A realistic and public dataset with rare undesirable real events in oil wells. Journal of Petroleum Science and Engineering, 181, 106223.
metadata.note: Synthetic well derived from the Petrobras 3W dataset.
